skills/schliff.description: Deterministic linter and scorer for instruction files — SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. No model in the loop: the same bytes score the same everywhere. Use for linting, scoring, auditing or CI-gating an instruction file, and for checking whether the commands a file promises actually resolve in the repo. Trigger phrases: "lint my skill", "score my skill", "audit skill", "review my skill", "harden skill", "make this skill better", "optimize my skill", "improve [metric] from X to Y", "benchmark skill", "check my AGENTS.md", "is my AGENTS.md lying", or paste a SKILL.md for auto-analysis.
